```sql
with order_attempts as (
    select
        o.order_id,
        max(case when a.status = 'captured' then 1 else 0 end) as succeeded
    from orders o
    join payment_attempts a on a.order_id = o.order_id
    where not o.is_test
      and not a.is_test
      and o.business_date between date '2026-09-01' and date '2026-09-09'
    group by o.order_id
)
select
    null as key,
    cast(sum(succeeded) * 1.0 / count(*) as decimal(38,12)) as value
from order_attempts
order by value
```
